company.name: Saudi Energy
company.shortDescription: Saudi Electricity Company (SEC abbreviated or SECO) is a Saudi Arabian power company headquartered in Riyadh.
company.description: Saudi Energy is an electric utility company that is engaged in power generation, transmission, and distribution. It supplies electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, and government customers and provides customer services, grid operations, and electricity consumption and energy management support.
